text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py, reserve_stock now validates warehouse_id format before any ledger load/append/save. A regex ^WH-(CPL|HGL|NVL)-\\d{2}$ is built from region_codes() (imported from config/settings), with the NN part restricted to 01-99. Malformed codes like 'WH7' raise ValueError('invalid warehouse id: ...') and record nothing in the ledger; valid codes like 'WH-NVL-03' pass through unchanged, including the insufficient-stock pending path.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
